lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 576 File Number Complaint No. 05-0157-955

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: There was nothin' covering her mouth? (Brendan shakes head “no”) Did she ask you not to do this to her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Tell me what she said.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: She told me not to do it so and told me not, to do the right thing.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Which was what?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Not, not to do it and tell Steven to knock it off.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did she ask you to do anything else for her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Ta uncuff her.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Go ahead. Anything else? (Brendan shakes head “no”) (pause) Were these things she was saying to you while you were doing this act?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Was she kinda sayin' it softly or loud enough or what?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well she was cryin' an.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: After you're done and you put your clothes on, what happens next?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He told me I did a good job and then he closed the door.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Took me in the living room, watched a little TV.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Both of you did? (Brendan nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: He didn't stay in the bedroom or go back in there?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (shakes head “no”) Uh uh.
